messages:
ana: Heads-up team — new experiment PE-MAY-26 needs a final decision on invoice stub vs immediate prorate. Goal: minimize support churn while keeping visibility.

jess: Strong vote for invoice stub (informational line, no charge). Simpler ledger and fewer reversals. Will draft support macro. :white_check_mark:

mike: Analytics: if we show stub, can we tag the stub lines with price_version so cohort reporting is clean? Need daily cohort exports.

sandeep: yes. we'll add X-Redwood-Price-Version header and invoice_line.meta.price_version = "PE-MAY-26". Also emit rw.pricing.stub.count metric. Estimate 0.5 day.

rebecca: Marketplace partners: must get SKU -> new-tier mapping. vendor-ops can auto-map ~88%, rest manual. If a Marketplace account wants legacy pricing we need a ticketed flow — partners won't accept retroactive adjustments without a ticket.

jess: For refunds/credits: cap credits to invoice amount and carry excess as account balance. That prevents negative invoices for annual prepay customers. Add that to the ledger spec.

ana: Legal note: wording on invoice must say "Informational: pending rate change will be applied at next billing cycle unless the account renews earlier." Olivia to sign off.

billing-bot: Reminder: billing calendar lock 2026-05-10 22:00 UTC — price metadata after lock applies to following cycle.

mike: Action items summary: 1) finance decision to use stub (jess + ana) — deadline Fri EOD. 2) eng header + metric + export (sandeep) — PR by Mon. 3) vendor SKU mapping (rebecca) — Tue EOD. 4) support macro and invoice blurb (jess) — Fri. 5) legal invoice wording (olivia) — Wed.

jess: Drafting support macro and invoice PDF blurb now. Will post in #support-desk for review.

sandeep: I'll include sample event payload for the daily export in the PR.

ana: Thanks — if vendor mapping or ledger flow has unresolved conflicts, escalate and we'll pause rollout by one billing cycle rather than risk invoice mismatches. :thumbsup:
